context_varying_parameters.name: age_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: Context eligibility and age margins differ. MIND bounded beta follows 61-80 and reported moments. Ayele binned beta follows Methods 25-64, reported imputed bins and moments with explicitly assumed within-bin densities. The target shifted gamma is a standalone demographic assumption with support 40 to infinity; source selection/timing is not imported.

context_varying_parameters.name: sex_composition
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND 2049/3547 is the supplied once-derived female ratio; Ayele uses 586/872 with the complementary male count 286/872. Target 0.56 is a scenario. Nearest-integer allocation conditions each generated cohort on approximately these fractions.

context_varying_parameters.name: bmi_distribution
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND lognormal moments use 25/3.6. Ayele uses category count ratios and unsupported within-category positive quantiles, explicitly assigning no gap mass. Target lognormal 27/6 is an unvalidated demographic scenario; the broader dispersion reflects assumed population heterogeneity rather than a target observation.

context_varying_parameters.name: dependence
context_varying_parameters.reason: Age-BMI latent correlations -0.12 MIND, +0.10 Ayele and -0.15 target represent an assumed modest age-related decline in the older contexts and rise over younger adult ages. Female BMI latent shifts 0.15/0.25/0.60 express context-dependent body-composition hypotheses. No selected source identifies these quantities. The mixture-CDF transform retains each BMI marginal while permitting this dependence.

context_varying_parameters.name: glucose_baseline
context_varying_parameters.reason: MIND persistent glucose moments use reported fasting-serum 5.2/1.4. Ayele provisional 5.0/1.4 allows an assumed younger population anchor, with no source continuous-glucose constraint. Target 5.2/1.6 borrows a location anchor and broadens dispersion for unmeasured selection/treatment heterogeneity; meal/device modifiers follow separately. These are not claims of assay equivalence.

context_varying_parameters.name: measurement_model
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source overnight serum, three-day capillary average and target pooled capillary reading require distinct observation models. Nonfasting references 0/0.50/0.55, device log SD 0/0.05/0.06, meal log increment 0.12/SD 0.10 and replicate counts 1/3/1 are explicit protocol-conditioned assumptions. Source variance already absorbs MIND assay noise. Original Ayele units/diagnostic rules remain contextual, and target cleaning effects are unidentified.
